caption: The drawing depicts a light brown bonnet with a slightly textured pattern, creating the appearance of woven straw. The bonnet has a wide, rounded brim and a tall, close-fitting crown. Wrapped around the base of the crown is a wide, pink ribbon adorned with small, repetitive decorative red marks, bordered by a white edge featuring a row of small grey dots or loops along both sides. The ribbon is tied in a large bow on one side, with two long tails hanging down; the ends are cut in an angled fashion and they show the same decorative edging as the ribbon around the crown. The background is plain and unadorned, with no additional objects or elements present.
title: Bonnet
